facts.text: Through the Excelsior Scholarship, eligible New York State residents from families with a combined federal adjusted gross income of $125,000 or less can attend SUNY Oneonta tuition-free.

sources.title: Excelsior Scholarship - SUNY Oneonta
sources.quote: The Excelsior Scholarship is an innovative, tuition-free program aimed at making an education more affordable for New York State families.

sources.title: Excelsior Scholarship - SUNY Oneonta
sources.quote: Have a combined federal Adjusted Gross Income of $125,000 or less
